title: SetErrorType::Display uses serde_json roundtrip
description: backend.rs:153-162: Display impl calls serde_json::to_value(self) to get the camelCase string, then matches on Value::String. This allocates a JSON Value and String on every Display call, which happens in every error message path. A &'static str lookup or a match directly on the enum variants would be O(1) with no allocation. Low impact in practice (error paths are cold), but the pattern is fragile: if serde serialization ever fails, Display silently outputs 'unknown' instead of panicking, which masks bugs.
